prompt: Traffic congestion is becoming worse in many rapidly growing cities. What do you think are the causes of this, and what solutions could be introduced?
essay:
Traffic jam is one of the biggest problem in the modern cities, especially in the developing countries where the population is growing very fast. In this essay I will explain the reasons of this problem and I will give some solutions.

The first reason is the rapid increase of the private cars. Nowadays, the car is not a luxury anymore and almost every family can buy one, so the number of the vehicles on the road is much more than before. Secondly, the public transport in many cities is very poor. The buses are old, they are always late and they are overcrowded, so people prefer to use their own car. Moreover, the road infrastructure is not developed enough. Many cities have narrow roads which were built many years ago and they can not handle the traffic of today.

There are several solutions for this problem. Firstly, the government should build more roads and flyovers to reduce the traffic. Secondly, the government should improve the public transport, for example by buying new buses and building the metro system. In addition, the people should use the carpooling or the bicycle for the short distance, and the companies can allow the flexible working hours so all the people are not travelling in the same time.

In conclusion, the traffic congestion is caused by the increasing of the cars, the poor public transport and the old infrastructure, and it can be solved by building more roads, improving the public transport and changing the habit of the people. The government and the citizens must cooperate to make our cities better.
title: Traffic congestion in growing cities
